content:
Hi everyone, I picked up Lean a fair bit recently, although I have had an on-and-off relationship with it for the last 5 years or so.

Last week, I wrote a proof of Residue Theorem for rectangular contours which I shared in #maths > Multivariate complex analysis , but it will likely be obsolete once a lot of the general machinery being built is complete. Nevertheless, I was very happy with how it came out.

This week, I decided to try and tackle an existing issue in mathlib, and I found #36134 to be a reasonable one for me to try. This didn't take me too long and I was able to complete and compile a proof of it. However, upon review by an AI, it immediately spotted that a lot of my proof was redundant since other general results could apply, and it came up with a nice alternate pathway to finish off, cutting down my proof length by half.

I have a PR for this here if you are interested. Any and all feedback would be great!

Thanks!
